summary: Verified new multi-player, per-player billing, snack assignment, and audit log features. Backend endpoints and frontend UI both work as specified. One minor testid inconsistency noted for the first ratio input.
passed: Admin & cashier login return valid JWT; login is audited (login action visible for both users).
Cashier GET /api/audit/logs -> 403 'Admin access required' as required by role gating.
Admin GET /api/audit/logs returns list with When/User/Role/Action/Entity/Details fields; filters (username=admin, action=session_open) work.
POST /api/sessions/open accepts players[] array (Test Amit ratio=2, Test Priya ratio=1); returns session with players list, ratios preserved.
POST /api/sessions/{id}/snacks accepts assigned_to (local player id) and null (shared); snacks stored with assigned_to field.

GET /api/sessions/{id}/preview-bill returns billing.per_player array with correct share_percent (66.67/33.33), table_share, snacks_share (Amit direct 40 + 20*2/3 shared = 53.33; Priya 20*1/3 = 6.67), subtotal.
POST /api/sessions/{id}/close writes per_player onto invoice (invoice INV-20260705-0006 contains per_player breakdown, payment_status=paid).
session_open, session_close, and login audit entries generated with correct details (table name, player list).
UI: /admin -> Audit Log tab (admin-tab-audit) renders; audit-username, audit-action, audit-from, audit-to, audit-run testids present; Filter button loads 10 rows with expected columns.
UI: Open Table modal shows multi-player controls; open-add-player-btn adds Player 2 with open-name-input-1, open-ratio-input-1, open-remove-player-1; open-confirm-btn present.
Single-player regression: existing running session (Table 1) still renders correctly on Dashboard; single-player close path continues to write invoice.

failed.issue: data-testid='open-ratio-input-0' returned count=0, while open-ratio-input-1 (after Add Player) is found=1. The ratio input for Player 1 is visually present and functional but its testid appears to differ from the spec.
failed.evidence: Playwright: 'open-ratio-input-0: found=0' but Player 1 ratio field is visible in modal screenshot; open-ratio-input-1 found=1 after clicking Add Player.

action_items: Verify data-testid on the first player's ratio input in OpenTableModal.jsx is 'open-ratio-input-0' (may be applied to wrapper or omitted for index 0). Minor - not a blocker.
